## Summary

Describe the scientific or engineering purpose of this change.

## Scope

- [ ] Code only
- [ ] Protocol or configuration
- [ ] New experimental wave
- [ ] Derived analysis/report
- [ ] Documentation only

## Reproducibility

- [ ] Canonical result files were not edited in place.
- [ ] New or changed results include task maps and source/config/environment identity.
- [ ] Comparisons use matched keys or explain their limitations.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/verify_repository.py` passes.
- [ ] Generated overview files are current.

## Leakage and security

- [ ] No test or validation data entered fitting outside the documented policy.
- [ ] No credentials, checkpoints, caches, private data, or raw logs were committed.
